name: agentmirror
description: Check what a coding agent says it did against what is actually in your repository, before you approve.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running tests executes the workspace's code and the command/python settings choose what is executed; both are ignored in untrusted workspaces.

commands.title: AgentMirror: Check the message on the clipboard
AgentMirror: Check the latest Claude Code session in this workspace
AgentMirror: Add the agent hook to this workspace (.github/hooks)
AgentMirror: Try the demo (see a verdict in 10 seconds)

agentmirror.command.description: The agentmirror executable (pip install agentmirror, or the path to it).

agentmirror.base.description: Git ref the agent started from. Empty: merge-base with the default branch, or HEAD for uncommitted work.

agentmirror.runTests.description: Also run the project's tests (in a network-denied sandbox on macOS). Executes the workspace's test code.

agentmirror.python.description: Python used to run tests (e.g. a virtualenv's python). Empty: the one running agentmirror.

agentmirror.testCommand.description: Test command; {py} is replaced by the python above. Empty: pytest.

agentmirror.autoOpen.description: Open the report panel automatically when an agent hook produces a new result (otherwise only the status bar updates).

agentmirror.useCI.description: Also read the project's CI results for HEAD (needs the GitHub CLI, gh).

agentmirror.notify.description: When an agent hook produces a result: show a notification for 'review' (contradicted claims) only, for 'always' (every turn, handy while testing), or 'never'. The status bar is updated either way.

chatParticipants.name: agentmirror
chatParticipants.description: Show AgentMirror's independent check of the last agent answer
